title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hook and metrics integration
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds per-prompt regression CI hook to fail PRs on prompt-set quality regressions; integrates eval metrics into CI dashboard.
description: Motivation: We currently run eval-harness end-to-end in nightly jobs, but developers need faster feedback when changes touch prompt sets or model-serving behavior. This PR adds a per-prompt regression CI hook that runs a targeted subset of evals on changed prompt-sets and surfaces metric deltas directly in the PR checks. Goals: 1) provide fast, actionable feedback for prompt and eval changes; 2) fail CI when quality regressions exceed configurable thresholds; 3) push eval metrics to the CI dashboard for trend visibility. Implementation summary: - New GH Action (eval/per-prompt-ci.yml) that detects changed prompt sets and runs their associated evals with a lightweight runner. - Per-prompt configuration file support (eval/config/prompts.yaml) to tune thresholds and metric weights. - Integration shim that posts summary metrics to the existing CI metrics exporter (observability-pack/ci-metrics-exporter). - Unit and integration tests covering runner orchestration and failure semantics. Checklist: - [x] GH Action for per-prompt CI - [x] Threshold config and defaults - [x] Metrics exporter integration - [x] Tests added and passing - [x] Docs updated with runbook and how-to (redwood-docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md). Related: ENG-1423 implements the config schema; SUP-3321 surfaced the need after a prompted production regression. This description intentionally keeps implementation details concise; see changed files for specifics.

review_comments: Miguel Ortega: Nice work. Two requests: (1) can we make the default regression threshold per-prompt 5% instead of 3%? We've seen noise on small prompts. (2) Add a short-circuit path for large prompt-sets to fall back to nightly full-eval.
